top_signals.title: Odd Lots: Europe may be falling behind. Working less isn’t why
top_signals.summary:
Some European countries work fewer hours but does that mean they're less productive?

Economist Dominik Leusder joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway on the Odd Lots podcast to talk about how research suggests that fewer hours worked actually lead to an increase in productivity. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Skydance co-CEOs Ellison and Kreiz speak with CNBC days after finalizing WBD acquisition
top_signals.summary: Skydance includes two film studios, the CBS broadcast network, a sprawling pay TV portfolio and streaming services Paramount+ and HBO Max.
